sentences.en: Sheldon, it's recess. Go outside, see what it's like.
sentences.ko: 셸든, 쉬는 시간이야. 밖에 나가서 좀 놀아보렴.

sentences.en: Are you by any chance Evelyn Ingram?
The same Evelyn Ingram who checked out this book?
sentences.ko: 이 책을 빌려 가셨던 그 에벌린 인그램이요?

sentences.en: And why is that your business?
I just assumed you were looking to make a friend.
Oh. Well, that was a long time ago.
sentences.ko: 아. 뭐, 그건 아주 오래전 일이야.

sentences.en: I had just gotten out of a very difficult relationship.
sentences.ko: 아주 힘든 관계를 막 정리했을 때였거든.
